dialogue.intro: Get your ranged gear together. Bring spare arrows so you don't run out halfway through a fight.
dialogue.progress: Check your gear and ammo before heading out.
dialogue.complete: That's the ranged gear sorted. Keep some spare ammo on you.

dialogue.intro: Found some bamboo? Bring a bit back and grow your own.
dialogue.complete: Plant some near your base so you don't have to keep looking for it.

dialogue.intro: Want a better bow? Check the compound bow recipe and get the materials together.
dialogue.progress: Gather what you need and make a compound bow.
dialogue.complete: Give it a try somewhere you've got room to aim.
